_comment: Region of interest per venue code, in metres relative to the PSMF GPS point (x east, y south), read off the orthophoto. The ROI isolates the pitch we actually play on so neighbouring pitches cannot merge into the same turf blob. 'sections' marks codes that are a numbered cross-pitch of a larger parent field rather than a standalone pitch (per the PSMF venue notes).

ARIT.note: Middle of three pitches at Aritma; the PSMF GPS point lands on it. The ROI stops in the gap before the full-size pitch to its east.

ASTR1.note: Court 1 of 2 at Astra: two futsal courts side by side on one carpet, each 19.9 x 45.05 m, sharing the line between them. PSMF marks this ground futsal-only. The halfway line and a centre circle 2.6 m in radius sit at 26.97 m, the exact midpoint, which is what fixes the ends. Numbered from the hall ('c. 1 blize hale'), which the imagery cannot place; both measure the same. diagnose.py reports a stronger line 1.1 m outside the east edge: that is the surround, not the court line, which reads 2-3x here.

ASTR2.note: Court 2 of 2 at Astra. See the ASTR1 note on the numbering.

BECH.note: Single artificial pitch beside the clay tennis courts.

CESMI.note: Single artificial pitch north of the natural-grass field. East edge nudged in: the automatic fit ran past the touchline onto the surround.

CZU.note: Single artificial pitch at the CZU sport centre; found on defaults, all four edges on the paint.

DEKAN.note: Single artificial pitch at SK Nusle; found on defaults.

HANSP.note: Single artificial pitch among the tennis courts. Pinned to the 2024 leaf-off capture: in summer flights a tree shadow swallows the east end. The search band starts 1 m inside the carpet because the bright teal kerb sits exactly where the touchline search would otherwise land.

HOSTI.note: Single artificial pitch at SK Hostivar. Genuinely a wide one -- 45.8 x 36.9 m, confirmed by a halfway line at the exact midpoint of the long axis -- not a merge of two.

HRAB1.note: Pitch 1 of 3 marked across the stadium field at Hrabakova, goals on the parent's touchlines. The parent's own markings (goal lines 6.4/95.7, penalty areas 22.4/79.6, halfway 51.0) are brighter than the cross-pitch lines and chroma sees the latter not at all, so the edges are measured, as at Prazacka. PSMF numbers from the restaurant ('c. 1 prvni zprava'), which the imagery cannot place; taken as running from the north. All three measure within a metre of each other, so the order costs little either way.

HRAB2.note: Pitch 2 of 3 at Hrabakova, the middle one. See the HRAB1 note.

HRAB3.note: Pitch 3 of 3 at Hrabakova. See the HRAB1 note on the numbering.

KORAB.note: Single artificial pitch. The paint sits 2.5 m inside the carpet on the west side and 4.3 m in on the east, and the carpet edge outshines it, so the search starts inside the turf as at Hanspaulka. The halfway line at 25.26 m confirms the goal lines at 2.56 and 47.96.

LITVI.note: Single artificial pitch at Sportcentrum Prosek; found on defaults.

MALES.note: Single artificial pitch. The north edge fitted the carpet edge, 5.7 m beyond the goal line; nudged onto the paint. Confirmed by the halfway line at 27.47 m, which is the exact midpoint of 5.52 and 49.42, and by penalty-area lines 5.9 m inside each.

METE1.note: Pitch 1 of 2 marked across the UMT field inside the running track, the western of the two and so the one nearer the kabiny (PSMF: 'c. 1 blize kabinam', which are past the main grass pitch to the west; confirmed by longitude). Each is 40.2 x 29 m -- the goal lines are the parent's touchlines, 40.2 m apart, which falls outside the 42-50 m the goal-line search accepts, so the rectangle is the measured one. The parent's own markings (goal lines 4.2/96.8, penalty areas 20.6/80.7, halfway 50.6) are far brighter than these.

METE2.note: Pitch 2 of 2 at Meteor, the eastern one, nearer Zenklova street. See the METE1 note. The search band is tightened here because the fit otherwise walked 3.3 m onto a marking inside the goal line.

MIKU1.note: Pitch 1 of 4 at Mikulova: the east column, north row. Four pitches are marked in two columns and two rows on one full-size field, which `sections` cannot express, and their paint is far fainter than the parent's, so the rectangle is the measured one. Each is 23.95 x 38.0 m; the margins and gaps sum to the parent's 101.8 m length exactly, and goal areas sit 5.85 m inside each end. PSMF numbers them from the kabiny ('c. 1 blizsi vpravo'), which the imagery cannot place, so which pair is 1/2 and which 3/4 is a guess -- all four measure the same.

MOTO1.note: Pitch 1 at Motorlet, the one behind the club's office building (PSMF: 'c. 1 je vpravo za administrativni budovou'); found on defaults. MOTO4 is the small pitch beyond the UMT field.

MOTO4.note: Pitch 4 = the small pitch beside the big UMT field (PSMF: 'c. 4 je za fotbalovym hristem s UMT'). Leaf-off capture gives the cleanest touchlines here.

P1.note: Pitch 1 of 3 at Prazacka: the eastern third, nearest the kabiny (PSMF: 'c. 1 nejblize kabinam'). Which end that is cannot be read off the imagery -- confirmed by hand, hence first_end E. Same parent and same measured edges as P2. We have no fixture here; measured so the number is ready if we are drawn on it.

P2.note: Pitch 2 of 3 marked across the stadium infield (PSMF: 'c. 1 nejblize kabinam', which is the east end). The three are 24 m wide with 5.7 m between them, all sharing goal lines 45.3 m apart. They cannot be fitted -- the parent's own goal, penalty and halfway lines are twice as bright as the cross-pitch ones -- so section_edges_m carries the positions read off the orthophoto instead of a fit plus a compensating nudge. Middle third, so unaffected by which end the numbering starts from.

P3.note: Pitch 3 of 3 at Prazacka, the western third and so the one furthest from the kabiny. See the P1 note on which end is which.

PLAM.note: One carpet with two pitches stacked across it, each 44.9 x 23.9 m with a 6.1 m gap; PSMF gives the ground a single code and the two measure the same. Section 1 is the northern. The division lines are white here, invisible to the chroma fit, so the edges are the measured ones.

PODV1.note: Pitch 1 of 2 at Podvinny mlyn: two pitches side by side on one carpet, each 27.75 m wide, sharing the line between them and a pair of goal lines 45.8 m apart. The division is white, invisible to the chroma fit, so the edges are measured. PSMF numbers from the toilet cabins ('c.1 blize bunkam'), which the imagery cannot place; both measure the same.

PODV2.note: Pitch 2 of 2 at Podvinny mlyn. See the PODV1 note on the numbering.

PRKOP.note: Single artificial pitch at FC Predni Kopanina; found on defaults.

SANC1.note: Left of the two adjacent pitches; north edge nudged in off a stray marking.

SANC2.note: Right of the two adjacent pitches; west and north edges nudged in off the surround.

SCBEC.note: The pitch sits inside a small running track; without an ROI the blob search wandered off to a roof 50 m north-east. The north edge then fitted the carpet edge 10 m beyond the goal line: the real pair is 10.13 and 50.03, confirmed by the halfway line at 30.03 and penalty areas 5.9 m inside each.

SLIVE.note: Single artificial pitch at AFK Slivenec; found on defaults.

STER1.note: Pitch 1 of 3 at Sterboholy -- the third nearest the hall, which is the west end and is visible in the imagery, so unlike Prazacka the numbering here is not ambiguous. No fixture of ours this season. The gap fit finds its side lines unaided; only the goal-line nudges are its own.

STER2.note: Pitch 2 of 3 marked across the big UMT field (PSMF: 'c. 1 je nejblize hale'). Side lines are faint blue, but the north goal line coincides with the white marking, so that edge is aligned to the white line rather than the blue. The three pitches do not touch: ~3.8 m of spare turf sits between them, so each has its own pair of blue side lines and section_gap_m lets the fit find them.

STER3.note: Pitch 3 of 3 on the same parent field as STER2, easternmost. North edge aligned to the white line as for STER2; south edge trimmed 0.4 m onto its own marking. Same ~3.8 m gap to its neighbour, hence section_gap_m.

STOD.note: The carpet runs 30 m east past the pitch and the pitch's own halfway line cuts the turf blob in two, so the detector sees a fragment -- the western half, goal line to halfway -- rather than a pitch. That fragment does give the angle and the width; the rectangle here extends it east by its own length to the far goal line, and the fit then settles it onto the paint.

TEMPO.note: Single artificial pitch at FC Tempo; found on defaults.

UJEZD.note: Our training pitch at Ujezd (Sokol, below Petrin). Not a PSMF venue; measured for comparison.

ZABEH.note: Single artificial pitch at the Ovcin centre; found on defaults.

ZAK.note: Single artificial pitch at TJ Sokol Vysocany; found on defaults.
